title: Readiness Estimator: Retinal Projection Systems
definition: Estimates Retinal Projection Systems readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Retinal Projection Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Retinal Projection Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Retinal Projection Systems — projecting images directly onto retinas.

Phase 1 — Prove (pico projectors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (eye tracking): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (safety limits): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
